_comment: TEMPLATE for scripts/acib-v3-freeze.mjs. Placeholders only: no author or reviewer has been appointed. The freeze refuses unless >=2 evalAuthors (none of them implementation authors), a reviewer sign-off by a non-implementer, successCriteriaConfirmedBy, and an evalPath OUTSIDE the repository. Declarations must be the verbatim texts of AQUA_ACIB_V3_DECLARATIONS.md (exported as AUTHOR_DECLARATION / REVIEWER_DECLARATION). C-5: founder and everyone in priorResultsExposed are barred from evalAuthors and reviewer; placeholders and future dates are refused.

evalAuthors.name: <independent author 1>
evalAuthors.declaration: I wrote the scenarios attributed to me. I have not read the assistant's source code, design documents, test results or earlier benchmark sets, and I have not discussed these evaluation scenarios with its engineering team. I have not included real personal data. Any filler conversations I wrote were written without knowledge of, or intent to favour, any particular system configuration, and do not change the correct answer to any question.

evalAuthors.name: <independent author 2>
evalAuthors.declaration: I wrote the scenarios attributed to me. I have not read the assistant's source code, design documents, test results or earlier benchmark sets, and I have not discussed these evaluation scenarios with its engineering team. I have not included real personal data. Any filler conversations I wrote were written without knowledge of, or intent to favour, any particular system configuration, and do not change the correct answer to any question.

implementationAuthors: <everyone who built the context engine or the hybrid context feature, including AI agents used for it>
priorResultsExposed: <everyone who has seen prior evaluation results, engine/hybrid internals or ACIB v1/v2 — including the founder>

reviewer.name: <independent reviewer>
reviewer.statement: I checked scenario counts and category balance, spot-checked at least 20 evaluation scenarios for a single defensible answer and reachable annotations, and hold the evaluation file outside the code repository. I am not an author of the assistant's engine or its hybrid context feature, and I have not shared evaluation scenarios with its engineering team.

evalPath: <absolute path OUTSIDE the repository, held by the reviewer>
